subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: standpipe riser location conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the standpipe riser location conflicting with the structural bracing at Room 214; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502. This needs a quick turnaround; work is stopped pending direction. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Room 214 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
